name: pilot
description: The pilot of design v2 section 9: one episode per scenario of pilot/scenarios_17.json, anchored at the scenario's date under the assumption that hyd_1 is hp_1 with one recorded cycle per day from 2022-07-01, with the recorded condition of that day hidden and the scenario text as the question. The driver fills start and question per scenario from pilot/anchors.py. The fault rule admits any number of faulty components, since an anchored day is not drawn under a rule.
